    def tarjan_scc():
        index = 0
        stack = []
        indices = [-1] * n
        lowlinks = [-1] * n

        sccs = []

        def strongconnect(v):
            nonlocal index
            indices[v] = index
            lowlinks[v] = index

            stack.append(v)
            on_stack[v] = True

                    strongconnect(w)
                    lowlinks[v] = min(lowlinks[v], lowlinks[w])
                elif on_stack[w]:
                    lowlinks[v] = min(lowlinks[v], indices[w])

            if lowlinks[v] == indices[v]:
                scc = []
                while True:
                    w = stack.pop()
                    on_stack[w] = False
                    scc.append(w)

                sccs.append(scc)

        for v in range(n):

        return sccs
